title: Finite eight-component Q3 energy-number form audit
question: For the actual full eight-component Q3 onsite Hamiltonian at finite oscillator cutoff, does the local harmonic number N^5 admit a finite matrix form bound by C(1+k_h^5) across a declared compact parameter fixture, and do independent constructions agree?
method: Construct the eight-component oscillator tensor matrices with the binary-cube Q3 internal edge potential and the declared shifted onsite Hamiltonian.
Compute the largest generalized eigenvalue C_fin of (N^5, I+k_h^5) and verify the residual matrix is positive up to tolerance.
Evaluate Gibbs and finite unitary-history number/energy ratios on the same matrices.
Repeat the construction with an independent tensor-factor lane and compile Lean R281 for the scalar ratio implication.
finding: The primary lane passes 99/99 assertions and the independent lane passes 30/30; the integrated verifier passes 74/74 with Lean R281. The full eight-component cutoff dimension is 2^8=256. Across the 3-by-3 (r,lambda) fixture, both lanes agree on every row; the largest finite generalized form ratio is C_fin=189.29695775387336 at (r,lambda)=(-1.25,0.0). The corresponding finite Gibbs ratio is 14.580856975. All tested finite energy minima are positive, generalized residual minima meet tolerance, and the unitary history checks pass. This closes only a finite canonical eight-component matrix form audit.
decision_reason: The actual vector Q3 onsite polynomial, rather than the corrected scalar proxy, now has a reproducible finite N^5 versus 1+k_h^5 form comparison. The generalized-eigenvalue constant is cutoff- and fixture-specific, so it is recorded as diagnostic evidence and not as the R-167 uniform graph constant.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite-matrix scope. No source-, volume-, oscillator-cutoff-, beta-, orientation-, or history-uniform constant is proved; no unbounded q/p-to-creation-annihilation domain transfer, actual Q3 common-core theorem, D-delta-D Cauchy estimate, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A closure follows.

adversarial_review.check: The matrix construction uses all eight binary-cube components and validates the twelve Q3 internal edges; the scalar EXP-001106 fixture is not reused.
The finite oscillator matrices have a cutoff boundary, so the residual is reported only on the declared 256-dimensional matrix space and no canonical commutator limit is inferred.
The denominator I+k_h^5 is checked positive and the largest generalized eigenvalue is used, so the reported C_fin is a valid finite form constant rather than a sampled-state maximum.
Nine compact parameter rows cannot establish uniformity in source, volume, cutoff, beta, orientation, or history.
A finite matrix ratio might be cited as the actual Q3 common-core, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, Sector A, or Pre-A theorem.

next_action: Extend the exact finite matrix audit to a declared increasing oscillator cutoff and spatial volume family, while deriving an analytic Shubin graph constant independent of those cutoffs; stop and register a scaling obstruction if C_fin grows without a compensating normalization.
